column1: The noise you made alerted Bains, but fortunately he missed and fled.
column2: 你弄出的聲音驚動了班恩斯，但幸好他沒有打中你便逃走了。

column1: You already have one.
column2: 你已經有一個了。

column1: You don't see a gas mask here.
column2: 你沒看到這裡有防毒面具。

column1: You take the last gas mask from the cabinet.
column2: 你從櫃子裡拿走最後一具防毒面具。

column1: It looks like your standard sewer gas mask.
column2: 看起來是標準的下水道防毒面具。

column2: 櫃子是關著的。

column1: You see a gas mask in the cabinet.
column2: 你看到櫃子裡有一具防毒面具。

column1: The cabinet is empty.
column2: 櫃子是空的。

column1: You see walkways and grates that lead around the dark and smelly sewer.
column2: 你看到人行通道和格柵，通往陰暗又臭氣沖天的下水道各處。

column1: On the wall, you see a cabinet that is %s.
column2: 你看到牆上有一個%s的櫃子。

column1: On one wall is a cabinet.
column2: 一面牆上有個櫃子。

column1: You will find the mask useful.
column2: 這具面具會派上用場。

column1: It's too dark in the hole to see anything.
column2: 洞裡太暗，什麼也看不見。

column1: The maintenance hole is for sewer personnel only.
column2: 維修孔僅供下水道工作人員使用。

column1: The cover is too heavy to push.
column2: 蓋子太重，推不動。

column1: Leave the hole alone...you can't climb down.
column2: 別管那個洞……你爬不下去。

column1: You are at a dead end.
column2: 你來到死路。

column1: There is a door here leading to ???
column2: 這裡有一扇門，通往？？？

column1: You wonder what's behind it?
column2: 你想知道門後面有什麼？

column1: Unfortunately, Bains was waiting for you.
column2: 不幸的是，班恩斯正在等你。

column1: You're at a dead end.
column2: 你來到死路。

column1: Marie squirms excitedly in her chair as you approach. She says "MUMBLE, MUMBLE".
column2: 你靠近時，瑪麗在椅子上興奮地扭動。她說：「含糊的喃喃聲，含糊的喃喃聲」。

column1: This is the control room for the sewer. There is a control panel on the back wall.
column2: 這是下水道的控制室。後牆上有一個控制面板。

column1: The gauges have normal readings.
column2: 儀表讀數正常。

column1: The control panel has controls, but they are complicated and unimportant to you.
column2: 控制面板上有各種控制裝置，但它們很複雜，對你也不重要。

column1: Pushing the buttons is not very constructive.
column2: 按那些按鈕沒有什麼建設性。

column1: You're a police officer, not a sanitation engineer.
column2: 你是警察，不是衛生工程師。

column1: You don't hear much except Marie.
column2: 除了瑪麗，你幾乎聽不到其他聲音。

column1: It smells only a little better in here.
column2: 這裡的氣味只稍微好了一點。

column1: You don't have the gas mask on.
column2: 你沒有戴上防毒面具。

column1: You don't have a mask.
column2: 你沒有面具。

column1: You don't need to wear the mask now.
column2: 你現在不需要戴面具。

column1: Ok...she's tied up and gagged...now what?
column2: 好……她被綁住又塞住嘴了……現在該怎麼辦？

column1: She already is!
column2: 她已經是那樣了！

column1: Move closer to untie her.
column2: 靠近一點替她解綁。

column1: She already is.
column2: 她已經是那樣了。

column1: After you tell Marie to keep quiet, Marie stops her struggling.
column2: 你叫瑪麗保持安靜後，她停止了掙扎。

column1: Marie is tied up in a chair.
column2: 瑪麗被綁在椅子上。

column1: Marie is nervous, but also excited to see you.
column2: 瑪麗很緊張，但見到你也很興奮。

column1: Marie is frozen in a state of panic.
column2: 瑪麗陷入恐慌，整個人僵住了。

column1: Marie is overjoyed to see you and excited that both you and her are safe.
column2: 瑪麗見到你欣喜若狂，也因為你們兩人都平安而興奮。

column1: First, she looks like she wants to be untied.
column2: 首先，她看起來想要被解開。

column1: Wait until later...
column2: 等晚一點……

column1: You have already done that.
column2: 你已經做過那件事了。

column1: Untie her first.
column2: 先替她解綁。

column1: Why say that now?
column2: 現在說那個做什麼？

column1: You yell out to Bains to halt.
column2: 你大喊叫班恩斯停下。

column1: You cautiously walk into the room...you can't believe your eyes when you see...
column2: 你小心地走進房間……當你看見眼前景象時，簡直不敢相信自己的眼睛……

column1: Marie! you mumble, under your breath.."I've located Marie!"
column2: 你壓低聲音喃喃道：「瑪麗！」……「我找到瑪麗了！」

column1: Showing excitement from seeing you, Marie struggles against her restraints.
column2: 瑪麗因為見到你而顯得興奮，努力掙扎著想脫離束縛。
